description: First page of top comments (about 20) on one YouTube video: author, verified/creator flags, text, like count text, reply count text and age text. Comments turned off or empty return an empty list. Reply threads and later pages are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_youtube_hashtag when you need videos on one YouTube hashtag page: video id, title; social_youtube_channel_email when you need YouTube channel About page from YouTube's public page data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: social_youtube_comments
